serValueType.description: Data serialization type. If not provided type will be inferred from source data

contentType.description: Content Type of the source data

contentEncoding.description: Compression / Content Encoding of this data

batchSize.description: Batch size to use during serialization if batch writing is used (Arrow format uses batching).

noCsvHeader.description:
If the CSV content does not have a header. By default, its false, which means we expect header to be present.
Useful to set as true when we don't know the header but know that it doesn't exist.

Only applicable when de-serializing CSV contentType.

csvHeader.description:
csvHeader is a comma separated list of fields that need to be written and is required when contentType is
text/csv. Leave this field as null for all other content types.

csvFormat.description: Optional format for a csv values. Key should be field path used in a csv header.

defaultCsvDelimiter.description: Default csv delimiter for target type. Used for text/csv files. Leave this field as null for all other content types.

defaultCsvEscapeChar.description: Default escape character for target type. Used for text/csv files. Leave this field as null for all other content types.

defaultCsvQuoteChar.description: Default quote character for target type. Used for text/csv files. Leave this field as null for all other content types.

avroSchema.description:
Avro schema for deserialization. If not provided, schema will be inferred from source data in the case of
file based avro data, and from the type in the case of in-memory avro data.

isObjList.description:
Indicates serialization/deserialization format for reading and writing Objs. If false, Objs will be written/read as
an array of serialized Obj instances, or alternatively, a single serialized Obj instance. If true, Objs will be
written/read in ObjList format, an object with two fields: "data", an array where each element is a serialized Obj,
and "type", the type shared by all Objs in the aforementioned array.

skipExtraFields.description: Optionally skip extra fields in serialized content instead of failing to serialize.

ignoreBadContent.description: If true will silently ignore bad syntax in the content and will return no or partial results.

mergeXmlNonAdjacentLists.description:
True if desired to merge the non-adjacent lists for array type field. If false, the readObjs only
returns the last continuous list for the given key.
E.g., to readObjs for the following xml file,
<tests>
  <test>one</test>
  <other>two</other>
  <test>three</test>
</tests>
with serType,
Tests {
  test: [string]
  other: string
}
If mergeXmlNonAdjacentLists is set true, the returned Obj has 'test' field containing both 'one' and 'three'.
Otherwise, the 'test' field only has value 'three'.

inplace.description:
If false, operations will be performed lazily, returning a {@link DataSpec}. If true, operations will be performed
in-place, meaning the Data will actually be modified (from end-user perspective).

deserialized.description:
If `true` data will be deserialized on Dataset#read and Dataset#cache operations. Otherwise it will be read or
cached in raw form, typically bytes.

cache.description: If `true` data will be cached in memory immediately on DataTable construction

save.description: If `true` snapshot of the data will be saved in a persisted store immediately on DataTable construction

saveLowLatency.description: If `true` snapshot of the data will be saved in a low latency persisted store immediately on Dataset construction

parallelReadChunkSizeMb.description: Suggested data size for a single chunk when using parallel reads

disableParallelRead.description: Do not use parallel reads from file system / database, I.e. each file will be read serially.

disableStringPooling.description: Do not use string pooling, i.e. do not use single instance for duplicate strings.

enableObjectPooling.description: Use single instance for all duplicate objects

failIfEmpty.description: Fail the read operation(s) if the source doesn't exist or is pointing to an empty directory.

sourceTable.description: Name of the source table for this view

projection.description: Fields names and corresponding expression in the scope of the parent dataset
